children: Daktronics reported first-quarter FY2027 results with revenue rising to $234.6M and diluted EPS of $0.4, compared with $219M and $0.33 a year earlier, as net income increased to $19.43M — reflecting growth in Live Events, Transportation and International activity.
Revenue was $234.6M, compared with $219M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 7.1%.
Net income was $19.43M, compared with $16.47M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 18%.
Diluted EPS was $0.4, compared with $0.33 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 21.2%.
Net sales rose 7.1% year-over-year to $234.6M, driven by higher volume in Live Events, Transportation and the International segment.
Orders declined 19.6% year-over-year and backlog fell to $311.3M, reflecting timing variability and a strong prior-year quarter.
International sales and commissions increased, signaling growing global demand and successful execution on large projects.
Operational progress included continued ramp of Mexico manufacturing, investments in digital and capacity initiatives, and planned capital expenditures of about $13.2M for automation.
